The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of common protocols in observational studies is important, but not sufficient to ensure that the results from different databases can be compared.
the use of common protocols in multinational comparative observational studies is a good first step towards more reliable results.
the use of a common protocol is a useful step in the direction of more comparable results between databases.
